tools.name: get_business_profile
tools.description: Get the WhatsApp Business profile (about, description, email, websites) for a phone number.

tools.name: list_message_templates
tools.description: List approved message templates for a WhatsApp Business Account.

tools.name: send_text_message
tools.description: Send a free-form text message to a specific recipient. Only works within the 24h customer service window unless the recipient messaged first.

to.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format, no leading +

tools.name: send_template_message
tools.description: Send a pre-approved message template to a recipient — the only way to start a conversation outside the 24h window.

to.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format, no leading +

tools.name: send_image_message
tools.description: Send an image to a specific recipient, from a public URL, a media ID already uploaded to WhatsApp, or raw base64 content (paired with mimeType). Only works within the 24h customer service window unless the recipient messaged first.

to.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format, no leading +

link.description: Public URL of the image. Provide this, mediaId, or contentBase64, not more than one.

mediaId.description: ID of media already uploaded via upload_media or the WhatsApp Media API.

contentBase64.description: Raw image content, base64-encoded. Requires mimeType.

mimeType.description: Required when using contentBase64, e.g. image/jpeg, image/png

tools.name: upload_media
tools.description: Upload media bytes to WhatsApp ahead of sending, returning a media id reusable across multiple send_*_message calls. Use this when the file isn't already hosted at a public URL.

tools.name: send_audio_message
tools.description: Send an audio message to a specific recipient, from a public URL, a media ID already uploaded to WhatsApp, or raw base64 content (paired with mimeType). Only works within the 24h customer service window unless the recipient messaged first.

to.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format, no leading +

link.description: Public URL of the audio file. Provide this, mediaId, or contentBase64, not more than one.

mediaId.description: ID of media already uploaded via upload_media or the WhatsApp Media API.

contentBase64.description: Raw audio content, base64-encoded. Requires mimeType.

mimeType.description: Required when using contentBase64, e.g. audio/mpeg, audio/ogg

tools.name: send_video_message
tools.description: Send a video to a specific recipient, from a public URL, a media ID already uploaded to WhatsApp, or raw base64 content (paired with mimeType). Only works within the 24h customer service window unless the recipient messaged first.

to.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format, no leading +

link.description: Public URL of the video. Provide this, mediaId, or contentBase64, not more than one.

mediaId.description: ID of media already uploaded via upload_media or the WhatsApp Media API.

contentBase64.description: Raw video content, base64-encoded. Requires mimeType.

mimeType.description: Required when using contentBase64, e.g. video/mp4
